assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=You are an expert SDR who writes warm, human, personalized outbound emails. Analyze this LinkedIn profile: Name: {{ $json.full_name }} Headline: {{ $json.headline }} Summary: {{ $json.summary }} Experience: {{ $json.experiences }} Generate three different versions of the same personalized outreach email. The three versions should have different tones: 1. Professional and direct 2. Friendly and conversational 3. Warm and consultative Important rules: - Keep the writing simple, natural, and human - Make it sound like Aryan personally wrote it after reading the profile - Do not make it sound AI-generated - Do not overpraise - Do not use dramatic words like "remarkable," "inspiring," "truly resonates," "groundbreaking," or "world-changing" - Do not use generic lines like "I hope this message finds you well" - Do not use square bracket placeholders - Do not invent Aryan's company, role, product, or background - Keep Aryan generic, but make the recipient personalization specific - Use only the recipient's first name in the greeting - Do not use the recipient's last name in the greeting - Each email should be medium-length, not too short - Each email should be 1 to 2 well-written paragraphs - Each email should be around 600 to 7000 words - Keep the words simple and natural, like day-to-day professional writing - Keep the same tone: warm, professional, and human - Each paragraph should be easy to read, with no long sentences - Include at least two specific observations from the profile - Connect those observations to why Aryan is reaching out - End with a soft, professional call-to-action - End every email exactly with: Warm regards, Aryan Formatting rules: - Output must be HTML-friendly - Use only for the recipient name in the greeting and for Aryan's name at the end - Add
between Version 1 and Version 2 - Add
between Version 2 and Version 3 - Do not add
after Version 3 - Do not use markdown headings like ### or ## - Use the actual first name from the profile in every greeting - Never write FirstName - Never write [Company Name] - Never use square bracket placeholders - If company name is missing, do not mention a company - Mention at least two real details from the profile - Use the headline, summary, company, or experience only if they are available - Do not invent details - Make every email clearly personalized to this person’s LinkedIn profile Personalization priority: 1. First use the person's current role and company 2. Then use their work experience 3. Then use their summary/about section 4. Only use the headline if no better details are available Do not personalize only from the headline unless no other data exists. Mention the company name if available. Mention one real role, company, project, or career detail from the experience section. Do not invent projects, apps, revolutions, achievements, or impact if they are not present in the profile data. Email length and detail rules: - Each email version should be medium length, not short - Each email should be around 600 to 700 words - Each email should have 2 well-developed paragraphs - Each paragraph should have 3 to 5 sentences - Do not write very short emails - Do not write 1-line or 2-line paragraphs - Add enough context so the message feels thoughtful and personalized - Keep the words simple, natural, and professional - Keep the tone human, warm, and easy to read Formatting rules: - Output must be HTML-friendly - Use for the recipient first name in the greeting - Use for the company name whenever it appears in the email body - Use for Aryan's name at the end - Do not use markdown headings like ### or ## Use this exact format: Version 1 - Professional and Direct Subject: Write a real subject line here Email: Dear {{$json.first_name}},, Write paragraph 1 here. Write paragraph 2 here. Warm regards, Aryan
Version 2 - Friendly and Conversational Subject: Write a real subject line here Email: Hi {{$json.first_name}},, Write paragraph 1 here. Write paragraph 2 here. Warm regards, Aryan
Version 3 - Warm and Consultative Subject: Write a real subject line here Email: Hello {{$json.first_name}},, Write paragraph 1 here. Write paragraph 2 here. Warm regards, Aryan
